pharmacology.text: 2C-T shows affinity for the serotonin 5-HT2 receptors and is known to act as an agonist of the serotonin 5-HT2A and 5-HT2B receptors. The drug shows no affinity for the monoamine transporters.
pharmacology.kind: Serotonin 5-HT2 receptor agonist; Serotonin 5-HT2A receptor agonist; Serotonergic psychedelic; Hallucinogen

uses.text: The drug was encountered as a novel designer drug in Europe in 2023.
